name: Concentration Curl
cues: Sit at the bench end with your knees wide apart
Brace the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder
Lower to a straight arm while your upper arm stays put

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Elbow goes 10 to 135 with the upper arm braced on the inner thigh, and the grip closes correctly (close-up checked).
